name: Reaction Wheel Torque Margin
description: Available torque from the reaction wheel assembly. Checks whether attitude manoeuvres can be completed within time.

elements.name: Available Reaction Wheel Torque
elements.description: Net torque available from the three-wheel assembly at operating temperature. Uncertain due to bearing friction and temperature.

uncertainty.source: Thermal-vacuum test data over temperature range

elements.name: Minimum Torque for Slew Manoeuvre
elements.description: Required torque to complete 30-degree slew within 5 minutes

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(τ_rw) = τ_rw if τ_rw >= τ_min, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The minimum slew torque requirement guards the reaction wheel torque uncertainty set; torques below 20 mNm cannot complete the required manoeuvre in time.
